correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the full three-dimensional multiplication from the original structure constants in the u=e1+e3,v=e2+e3,w=e3 basis: u²=0, uv=u, v²=-u+λv, uw=vw=w²=u. Since E²=Ku+Kv is characteristic and λ≠0, its square-zero locus is precisely Ku. An arbitrary automorphism has φ(u)=αu, φ(v)=v+βu, φ(w)=pu+qv+cw. The six products force α=1+(λ−2)β, q=0,c=1,p=α−β−1 and (4−λ)β=0. Independent symbolic substitution reproduces the one residual (λ−4)β. If λ≠4, identity is forced; if λ=4, admissible φβ has determinant 1+2β and composition parameter t=1+2β multiplies, giving K×. In characteristic 2, λ=4=0 is excluded, so all fields and finite-field counts follow without an enumeration.
